incomeAssessment.scope: Targeted LA household food, housing assistance, private care payments and participant/caregiver access costs; partial clinical reference retained.
incomeAssessment.rationale: Actual free services and short-term assistance establish resource pathways, but current unique households, retained amounts and alternative private-payment incidence are unidentified. No invented cash central is supplied.
directions: Joint food, housing and care gains require actual displaced purchases or retained assistance, net taxes and benefit withdrawals, finite duration and additionality against funded public programs.
Full transport, paperwork, time and caregiver burdens survive clinical null; positive health overlap limits gains only.
Provider pharmacy receipts and retail medicines are not household cash; public financing and real-resource costs remain separate.
